prompt: Review this pull request and leave inline comments on the lines that need changes.
setup: An open pull request contains a multi-hunk diff.
The authenticated account can review the pull request.
expected: Line numbers are derived from the diff, not guessed.
Inline comments target only lines present in the diff.
The review is submitted exactly once.
must_not: Comment on a line absent from the diff.
Submit or retry the review more than once, creating duplicate threads.
